definitions.explanation: A group of trees smaller than a forest, often in or near populated areas.

examples.japanese: {林|はやし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：02885_sanpo⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk through the woods.
There's a grove near my house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{竹林|ちくりん}→竹林：15110_chikurin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.notes: 竹林 uses different reading (ちくりん)

examples.english: There's a small pond deep in the woods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→たち：10079_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{林|はやし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing in the woods.

notes:
{林|はやし} refers to a smaller wooded area than ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧ (forest).

{林|はやし} vs ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧:
- {林|はやし}: woods, grove (smaller, often human-managed)
- ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧: forest (larger, more natural/wild)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{竹林|ちくりん}→竹林：15110_chikurin⟧/たけばやし: bamboo grove
- {雑木林|ぞうきばやし}: thicket, copse
- {松林|まつばやし}: pine grove
- {林業|りんぎょう}: forestry

Note: {林|はやし} is also a common Japanese surname.
